authorization_scope: User requested creation of the candidate table; no outreach, purchase, laboratory work, M0 control acceptance or AWF dispatch recorded.

scope.purpose: Initial public-literature boiling-range and reported-flammability screen; not full coolant qualification
scope.inclusion_rule: Named single molecular compounds with 1-6 carbon atoms, containing only C/H/O/N/S/Cl and no fluorine; catalogue/literature leads in or near the boiling window. Chlorinated compounds are retained, not silently excluded. Mixtures and invented molecules are out of scope.
scope.search_design: Purposive family-based seed list and adjacent exclusion controls, not exhaustive enumeration. Prior review already supplied knowledge of several entries including trans-1,2-dichloroethylene; this is not a blinded preregistration. New leads from the current searches are recorded before the bulk property extraction.
source_order: NIST Chemistry WebBook for boiling data and identity
Chemical manufacturer product records/SDS for flash points and classifications
scope.classification_rule: Use NIST Tboil compilation where available; retain multiple reported values and uncertainty. IN_RANGE only when the retained evidence interval lies within inclusive 45-55 C, OUT_OF_RANGE only when wholly outside, otherwise BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED. Supplier-only boiling values without explicit pressure remain PROVISIONAL_PRESSURE_UNKNOWN. Missing values never pass.
scope.fire_rule: No application fire limit has been approved. Report flash-point sign and supplier classification descriptively. A separate conditional no-GHS-Flam-Liq-1-2-3 scenario may be evaluated, clearly marked as an analyst scenario, not an owner/OEM requirement. Zero-degree flash point is not a suitability criterion.
scope.coverage_limits: Not all NIST compounds enumerated; no claim of 100% recall or chemical-domain impossibility. Organosilicon, other halogens, inorganic compounds, mixtures and novel molecules are outside this pass.

method.screening_interval: Envelope of retained NIST Tboil values and reported ±/TRC uncertainty. This is a conservative source-consistency check, not a physical uncertainty distribution. No silent outlier removal.
method.pressure_policy: NIST Tboil entries treated under the normal-boiling convention (101.325 kPa); unqualified supplier bp does not independently prove pressure. Reduced-pressure rows are not used.
method.flash_policy: Supplier value/method retained; alternative sources retained separately. Inequalities remain inequalities. UNKNOWN is distinct from no flash point.
method.no_zero_degree_gate: Flash-point sign is descriptive and is not a coolant acceptance rule.
method.no_ghs_imputation: No GHS category inferred from molecular identity or NIOSH class. Manufacturer hazard statements remain separately labelled.
method.source_completeness: Seed search, not exhaustive NIST/database enumeration; full underlying papers and experimental test reports not obtained.
method.review_status: LLM-assisted extraction and self-check; no independent chemist/thermal approval.

summary.reason: One in-range compound disproves the predicted zero positive-flash-point count, but remains flammable. The bounded search and missing critical evidence do not establish either a viable coolant or impossibility of the full domain.
